messages:
maya: Morning — quick cadence check for Thursday's train. Who's landing the analytics-dashboard PRs and what time are we aiming for the canary window?
eli: I can take analytics-dashboard (PR #4187). planning to push at 14:15 PT. Can we run a 30m canary?
sara: 14:15 +30m sounds good. I'll own smoke checks for that lane.
toni: i'm on infra for the week — i can watch metrics and cut traffic back if latency spikes. ping me right away.
maya: awesome. eli can you post the exact deploy command and the smoke checklist here so sara has it?
eli: sure — deploy command is: 
```
./deploy --service analytics-dashboard --image redwood/analytics:prod-2026-03-17 --timeout 600
```
smoke checklist (brief):
- health endpoints green (/health, /metrics)
- traces sane (latency P95 < 350ms)
- error rate < 0.2%
- frontend feature flags enabled
- run local quick end-to-end on staging flags
(sara will run these)
sara: copying checklist. i'll post quick results in this thread as checks complete.
jamie: i'll be the rollback owner for analytics-dashboard — if we see >0.5% errors or P95 > 500ms for 5m, rollback to prod-2026-03-10 tag.
maya: good. can we coordinate the other lanes? cc @toni for infra ordering.
eli: other PRs queued: feature/usage-export (#4192) and bugfix/session-leak (#4199). i'd like to batch usage-export with analytics since it's low risk, but hold session-leak for next wave unless we have a free slot.
toni: ordering proposal: 14:15 analytics (eli), 14:50 usage-export (eli), 15:30 ui-hotfix (sara). spacing keeps observability clear.
maya: +1. canary windows: analytics 14:15-14:45, usage-export 14:50-15:10.
sara: i'll do smoke for analytics and ui-hotfix. eli can you add a smoke flag to usage-export deploy? small rollout only.
eli: will do. adding --rollout-percentage 10 for usage-export.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: analytics-dashboard by eli at 2026-03-19T14:15:00Z (canary 30m) — watch /dash/deploy/4187
maya: quick QA: who is the code reviewer for session-leak? we need an ok before we consider it.
jamie: i'll take a look at session-leak tomorrow morning, but won't land it today.
maya: perfect. last ask — post smoke results as short bullets, and drop a :thumbsup: if everything looks green so we can move to generic rollout after the canary.
sara: will do. I'll start checks at 14:17 and update here.
eli: thanks all — i'll post the CI-green and exact image hash ~15m before deploy.
maya: great. tagging runbook owners: @jamie rollback, @toni infra, @sara smoke. see you all in thread updates. :rocket:
